book.name: Gutut
book.title: Gutut Iesu watu enamot mega nagire guturewa

content: Apan Konilias Pita menan wan
Pa Sisaria gapan ap mepe apan da yaua Konilias iniwandin. Me Rom ita nagirewa arita mugawa at Italia gapan.
Me God menan pot pot anu taiwandini gapan dugup mega den God wa taragasiwanumun. Kayakayawan nagirewa wat agoat mumiwandin amba pot pot me God inap mup waiwandin.
Wam da, wam airase yampoa wareni gapan me bet ine God anea mega da aroga pa unugiwandini yaven. Anea anega dien, “Konilias!”

Boge Konilias tap tan, kem kem yaviwandini gare singui anega wan, “Ayop, dim da?” Anea ame gare wan, “Ge mup gega waingian amba kayakayawan nagirewa wat agoat mumingiana ame God yao anu gimagiwan ap menan ge garaet gega genapen taiwan.
Menan endi ge apan da watu enamo pa Diopa amo apan da yaua Saimon Pita wat onamop.
Me man epi getaven darakamini apane dawa yaua Saimon den wandiwan. Pa ame puiman etop tun.”

Nop ame dieni gapan anea boge ae ve aen. Konilias nao mega apanewa dere amba ita apanewa daiton munan wan tauan. Ita apane God menan pot pot anu taiwandini apanewa, Konilias inap ayamase kaimakaet di tainiwa.
Me dim dim iragi inap venaseni oisewa wadiamon amba watu enamon pa Diopa amon.
Pita bet ine yaven
Inane woup sen, wam ianupe wareni mu ap wandap amon amba pa sewa Diopa maniwanumune, ap wamewa gapan, Pita pa aigarip mup wapen dot aen.
Mup waiwandini enup aren nat anun. Go pa gwanap antaba ewake wat iriwanumune. Ame gapan Pita bet ine manega yaven.
Me kiman watapen ao yaven amba yawat mega wanup baware da mini ginewa degede en memegamen aoma piupa visiwandini yaven.
Wanup ame gwanapewa man tap gine ugup ugup, ame wariwa ge mokare den gine ugup ugup amba nenip gine ugup ugup wanumone yawamon.
Boge nop da kiman gapan anega wadien, “Pita, ao yona, gut na.”
Pita gare wan, “Ayop ame umap uon! Ne antaba koeragewa ian ugupe nagire mugawa iup gega topaitapena tawa menan ne ya nainawa.”
God sia wan, “God taba dim dim da kakae diamoni ge koerage ya dia.”
Mame koni yampo venaseni amba wanup ame ene wabore ewagai kimani sia aen.
Pita bet ine yaveni ame tavewa dim da menan anu waramase wande anuan sese taiwandini newap Konilias watu enamoni apan yampo Saimon pa mega yoa tan, wa ewamon, tauane pa tonana yonan.
Mu yonane singui wan, “Daio apane yaua Saimon Pita mapa iniwan go?”
Pita wande bet ineni ame tavewa dim da menan anuan sese taiwandini gapan Guewa Woup Seniwa anega wadien, “Saimon, apan yampo yoga taiwanum.
Ao yon vit ak. Mu tanam agepen menan gego ya anu iwa ne watu enamon.”
God Guewa wani menan, Pita vit ae amba apan ame anega diamon, “Yoa taiana apanewa ne mame. Iwa dimen ma onayan?”

Mu gare anega wan, “Ita apanewa Konilias watu enanen tauaton. Me apan kakaewa, God wa taragasiniwa amba waenapan iragi me viriwa tainewa. God anea mega da Konilias wadieni menan nu ge nauge pa mega anet, amba ge nop dim da wawa me anupen menan wan.”
Boge Pita apan ame upamo pa mega gwanap semon inane. Inane woup sen, mu Pita upan den nau amon amba Iesu dugup mega nagirewa upi pa Diopa gapanawa mu den tanam amon.
Pita apan Konilias ine aen
Wam ame amuin en inane, sia amon at Sisaria tauan. Ap mepe Konilias amba dugup mega evene wai den munan wani tauan, amase taiwanumun.
Pita pa unuk aepen taiwandini Konilias tautane namup geare wa taragasen.
Go Pita nanip ao ware anega wan, “Ao yon, ne den apan iragen di, ne bawarewa uon.”
Amba mu dere nop waiwanumune pa unuk amone amba Pita waenapan aruga ame to iam tan wanumone yawamon.
Pita mu anega wadiamon, “Nu Diu gutut nuga e anuiwanin. Diu uon ian ugupe nagirewa den union ya waninait, pa ega daio ya anait. Go endi waenapan da imumu koevet ya diaepen menan God ewanegen.
Ap menan nenan wayan ne tanda ya wan boge di ongen. Go endi ne singui wayawaivin, e sepana dimen watu enamoyan?”
Konilias gare wan, “Wam degede taue ewanup aeni gapan wan airase yampo, ma miniwa, ne pa nega gwanap mup taingina apan da wanup mega ganase den namunap yone
amba anega wan, ‘Konilias, God mup gega anun amba kayakayawan taine nagirewa wat agoat mumingiana ame yawage anun.
Ap menan sep nagire ame pa Diopa watu enamo apan Saimon ame yaua dawa Pita nau onamop. Me man epi getaven darakamini apane dawa yaua Saimon ame pa mega puiman etop iniwan.’
Menan ne sep gine tutut genan watu enan, amba ame ongeana kakae di. Ap menan endi nu iravi ma mepe God namup iam iam taivin amba Ayop nop wadiageni ame nu wadiane anut anuivin.”
Pita opata megawa
Pita opata ere manega wan, “Ne endi di anu kakayasivin ame God yamap waenapan iragi gine daiton di.
Piup at at iragi gapan waenapan da da God wa taragasepi nop mega ayamase ta amopi God waupamota.
God oit mega Isurero nagirewa inamup watu eneni e asik tayan. Oit kakaewa ame Iesu Keriso tani menan God baigananu tani anuton. Ap menan Iesu wan dim dim iravi Ayopewa.
At Diudia gapan dim da venaseni e anuiwanin, ame namu at Galili dup iamopen oisewa Dion opata gapan waiwandini amba

God anenen da Iesu at Nasaret apanewa Guewa Woup Seniwa aroewa gapan uriri tan, amba Iesu yone at at iravi nao mega kaimakaet taiwandin amba da da Seitan nani gwanap wanumuine nagirewa wat inakam mumiwandin, iwa God me den inap wande en, ame iravi e anuyan.
Iesu pa Ierusalem amba pa ugup ugup den nao taiwandin yavintoni oisewa waivin. Amba mu oma korosi gapan tobatamen endawane boen,
go wam yampoa gapan God wan me inakae sia yon wanden, ame tani ewap Iesu waenapan inamup taueni yawane.
Waenapan iragi ya yawane, go God gaset om enunen Iesu boe sia yon wandeni ewap taba kaum den natoni nagirewa nugenat yawaton.
God nu Iesu oisewa kakaewa waenapan at at iragi wadiamopen dianen amba God daiton me Iesu om enuni ame kabaniwa ge borit wane nagirewa wanene tamopi oisewa God wadidiamopen dianen.
Watagaet God no oise waiwanumune nagirewa me guturewa manega wane, da da Iesu anu tumasepiwa me gamup God koewa muga anu ae veta.” Pita ap anega wan.
God Guewa Woup Seniwa ian ugupe nagirewa potamup tauen
Pita nop opata waiwandini gapan, opata anuiwanumune nagirewa Guewa Woup Seniwa aigamup visen.
Pita, at Diopa gapan tanan onamone Iesu anu tumasine ian Diu nagirewa, nomu i kap wan. Iwa Guewa Woup Seniwa God garaet Diu nagirewa muneni endi ian ugupe aigamup wagemeni yawane menan.
Amba Guewa aroewa gapan mu merimu tobayanen ian ugup ugup nop muga wane amba God wa atonasiwanumune, Diu nagirewa anun. Menan Pita anega wan,
“Waenapan mam, nu umanup God Guewa potamup tauen. Ap me menan iragi kaum gapan dup iamopen menan da watanamota?”
Wani Iesu yaua amun mega gapan dup iamopen diamon. Dup iamone amba pa nagirewa Pita wam upi den ap mepe wanumot wane.
